notes: Record keeping and privacy: case notes lock 30 days after they are written (an addendum corrects them) and every earlier version of an edited note is kept; adult clients sign their own release of information (by email or recorded from paper), valid for one year, with warnings before a report goes to a recipient no release covers; email subjects no longer carry client names; a Vendor agreements page records business associate agreements. Includes 3.0.35 (referral outcomes and case closure) and 3.0.34 (getting paid). Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.34.sql, mig_3.0.35.sql and then mig_3.0.36.sql before updating files (safe to re-run). Sites below 3.0.31 also apply mig_3.0.31.sql; Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.31.sql (confirms client emails waiting for confirmation). Sites below 3.0.28 apply mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27, 3.0.28, 3.0.31, 3.0.34, 3.0.35 and 3.0.36 in order; all are safe to re-run.
